sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT COALESCE(DATEADD(hour, -1, MAX(last_refresh_utc)), '1900-01-01') AS last_refresh_utc
FROM [meta].[refresh_metadata]
WHERE table_name = '@{replace(item().Name, 'dbo.', 'raw_ccdata.')}'
